outcome: Postpartum flare up of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE)
Acute decompensated heart failure mimicking postpartum cardiomyopathy
cohort: A 33-year-old pregnant woman who underwent a caesarean section at 38 weeks.
finding: This case report highlights the challenge in diagnosing SLE cardiomyopathy postpartum as it can mimic postpartum cardiomyopathy, emphasizing the need to consider various etiologies for heart failure with reduced ejection fraction in the postpartum period.
